retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist surrealist composition featuring a central iris-like circular element and a silhouetted human figure against a vast neutral field.

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, conceptual composition on a warm-white field. It features a central circular 'iris' containing a macro eye texture and a metallic pipe fitting, a desaturated silhouette of a person whispering in the lower-left, and subtle, colorless embossed typography in the upper-right.
coreVisualRelationships: The central circular portal acts as the primary focal point against the negative space.
The human silhouette in the lower-left creates a diagonal tension with the embossed text in the upper-right.
The metallic pipe within the iris provides a sharp, industrial contrast to the organic eye texture.
coreInvariants: Low-contrast, desaturated human figure in the foreground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central circular graphic at 25% scale; human silhouette in bottom-left corner at 40% scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, textured circular iris in the center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the human figure's gaze/gesture toward the central circle, then upward to the subtle embossed text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of negative space (approx 70%) to create a sense of clinical isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm-white/Beige background providing a neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep browns and blacks within the central iris.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cool metallic silver/white on the pipe fitting.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation overall, with a concentrated burst of dark value and medium saturation in the center.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are rendered as blind embosses (no ink, only shadow and highlight from depth)
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic hierarchy using depth instead of color.
graphicDevices: Soft-edged drop shadow for the silhouette

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the sturdy slab-serif structure seen in the top text.
Geometric clarity for the secondary embossed block.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a minimalist scene on a warm-grey paper texture. Place a desaturated, low-contrast silhouette of a person's head and hands in the bottom-left. Center a perfectly circular graphic containing a macro iris texture with a white metallic L-joint pipe in its center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply all-caps slab-serif text at the top and a block of geometric sans-serif text in the upper-right. Render the text using a 'blind emboss' layer style with subtle highlights on the top edges and soft shadows on the bottom edges to simulate physical depth without ink.

verificationChecks: Is the central circle perfectly centered?
Is the text rendered as a colorless physical impression?
Is the background a consistent, warm-neutral tone?
Does the silhouette appear integrated into the background via low contrast?

mustRedesign: Do not use high-contrast black ink for the main title
Ensure the pipe fitting is generic and not a branded product

mustAchieve: Balanced use of vast negative space
avoid: Heavy drop shadows on the central circle

postGenerationChecks: Check that the embossed text is legible through shadow/highlight only.
Verify the central iris has a macro, organic texture.
Ensure the silhouette is desaturated to match the background tone.
Confirm the composition feels 'quiet' and minimalist.
recipe.reuseFormula: Minimalist field + Central circular surreal motif + Corner silhouette + Blind embossed typography = Conceptual Surrealism
